pages.text: The skill system ($(bold)Pufferfish's Skills$(/bold)) provides six skill trees with deep investment paths. Skill points are earned through FTB Quests — completing quest paths rewards points, not combat.$(br2)$(bold)Opening the skill menu:$(/bold) Default key $(bold)K$(/bold).$(br2)$(bold)Respeccing:$(/bold) 5 XP levels per point refunded. Full respec is possible but expensive.

$(bold)The Six Trees$(/bold)$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Warfare$(/bold) — Melee damage, weapon mastery, combat stats$(li)$(bold)Marksman$(/bold) — Ranged damage, arrow handling, precision$(li)$(bold)Sorcery$(/bold) — Spell power, mana, cast efficiency$(li)$(bold)Fortitude$(/bold) — HP, defense, regen, resistance$(li)$(bold)Gathering$(/bold) — Mining, farming, fishing, luck$(li)$(bold)Engineering$(/bold) — Crafting, machine bonuses, automation speed

$(bold)Point Budget$(/bold)$(br2)A fully completionist player who finishes every quest in every tier earns approximately $(bold)75 skill points$(/bold) total. Each tree has 40 levels of investment.$(br2)$(bold)240 total points$(/bold) would be required to max all six trees — this is intentionally unreachable. Build choices matter. You will specialize.$(br2)Anti-farming: Pufferfish Unofficial Additions prevents grinding specific XP sources for points.

$(bold)Tree Structure$(/bold)$(br2)Each tree has:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)8-node trunk$(/bold) — always available, foundational bonuses$(li)$(bold)2 branches$(/bold) — unlock after trunk nodes, specialize into substyles$(li)$(bold)1 capstone$(/bold) — requires near-full tree investment, powerful late bonus$(br2)Branching at each fork is exclusive — you choose one branch or the other. Not both.
